Dear Captain,

Could you please verify the VLSFO consumption figures for 22 Jan 2025 — tank soundings and flow meter readings — as reported: 27.6 t versus the charter party warranty of 24.0 t/day, an excess of 15.0%. Thank you for your confirmation.

Best regards,
